title: fix(optimizer): respect importer module format for dynamic import interop with CJS deps
label: docs-relevant
rationale: Dynamic import() of a CJS dep previously derived its interop shape from the legacy.inconsistentCjsInterop flag alone; now it derives from whether the importer's own module format is explicit (isFilePathFormatExplicit). Changes the emitted interop code — and therefore the observed default export — for real user code, against a documented legacy config option.

label: not-relevant
rationale: Captures the Buffer binding at module load instead of dereferencing it lazily, so deleting globalThis.Buffer later doesn't crash source-map decoding. Internal robustness fix inside the module runner; no documented API, option, or output changes.
